mapper.select: select e.emp_id, e.emp_no, e.emp_name, e.com_id, e.emp_email, e.emp_mobile, e.emp_status, e.dept_id, d.dept_name, e.pos_id, p.pos_name, to_char(e.hire_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as hire_date, to_char(e.created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as created_at, to_char(e.updated_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as updated_at from employee e join emp_position p on e.pos_id = p.pos_id join department d on e.dept_id = d.dept_id where e.emp_id = #{empId} and e.com_id = #{comId}
mapper.insert:
insert into employee (emp_no, emp_pass, emp_name, dept_id, pos_id, com_id, emp_email, emp_mobile, emp_status, hire_date, must_change_pwd) values (#{empNo}, #{empPass}, #{empName}, #{deptId}, #{posId}, #{comId}, #{empEmail}, #{empMobile}, #{empStatus}, to_date(#{hireDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'Y')
select seq_employee.currval from dual
mapper.update: update employee set emp_name = #{empName}, dept_id = #{deptId}, pos_id = #{posId}, emp_email = #{empEmail}, emp_mobile = #{empMobile}, emp_status = #{empStatus}, hire_date = #{hireDate} where emp_id = #{empId} and com_id = #{comId}
mapper.select: select count(*) from employee where emp_email = #{empEmail}
select count(*) from employee where emp_mobile = #{empMobile}
select count(*) from employee where emp_no = #{empNo} and com_id = #{comId}

select e.emp_id, e.emp_name, e.emp_no, e.com_id, e.dept_id, d.dept_name, e.pos_id, p.pos_name, ea.emp_aut_id, a.aut_id, a.aut_name from employee e join emp_position p on e.pos_id = p.pos_id join department d on e.dept_id = d.dept_id join emp_auth ea on e.emp_id = ea.emp_id join authority a on a.aut_id = ea.aut_id and e.com_id = a.com_id where e.com_id = #{comId}

select e.*, d.dept_name, p.pos_name, c.com_name from employee e join department d on d.dept_id = e.dept_id join emp_position p on p.pos_id = e.pos_id join company c on c.com_id = e.com_id where e.emp_email = #{empEmail}
